title: 第2002章 是是非非了尽尘缘大结局第2001章 流尽生命之火
lines: 第2002章是是非非，了尽尘缘（大结局）
“哈哈～！”东华帝君大笑道：“人不为己，天诛地灭，你以为我东华帝君和你陈默一样重情重义吗？在我眼里，只要可利用之人皆可成为棋子，至于感情，那就要看这棋子对我是否能够发挥作用。”
“好一个人不为己，天诛地灭，东华帝君，我小看你了。”
陈默开口说道：“此时的战斗已是陌途，东华帝君，我本将心向明月，奈何明月照沟渠，你我之间，必有一死，但在此之前我先处理家事。”
陈默话音落下，大手一挥，主宰之力笼罩陈凡体外，瞬间便是让陈凡的神色陷入了无尽的痛苦，他的五行之力和一切力量被陈默硬生生剥夺。
仅仅是一瞬间，陈凡就成为一个毫无修为的凡人。
见到这一幕，轮回道尊嘴角抽搐，“陈默，你怎么能剥夺陈凡的力量？”
听了这话，陈默淡淡说道：“陈凡生于五行世界，他所拥有的一切都是我陈默赐予，包括生命，你东华帝君不是一个合格的下棋者。”
此言一出，宛若一巴掌打在东华帝君的脸上，使得他的神色难看至极。
他竟然不是一个合格的下棋者。
多少年了，东华帝君还是头一次失败，还要败在他徒弟的手里。
不过，东华帝君很快收回了难看的神色，目光再度望着陈默也是怀疑之意，“陈默，纵然我失去陈凡这一颗棋子，但我还有其他方法对付你，并且以我的实力完全能够将你就地击杀。”
“最后一战，我若败，河图洛书归你东华帝君。”陈默回答了东华帝君的话，东华帝君微微点头道：“我若败，世界归你陈默掌管。”
陈默劈开轮回道，将陈凡融入轮回，然后望着东华帝君心无杂念。
这一刻，他知道，自己要和东华帝君决一生死，结果将会影响整个仙界的格局。
就在这时，东华帝君惜字如金，向陈默走了过来，身外化身从他体外呈现而出，这些身外化身都有天尊修为，显得强大非凡。
那股可怕的力量让陈默心头沉重，主宰之力从他体外汇聚而生，融入五脏六腑，四肢百骸，让陈默整个人看起来有十足恐怖的气势。
“嘭！嘭嘭！”东华帝君的的攻击不断落在陈默体外，空间炸裂出毁灭的力量，使得陈默周身升起五行之力，旋即这股五行之力化作了护体罡气，河图洛书更是盘旋出三百六十度的光华。
嗡嗡嗡！
陈默一步步往东华帝君走了过去，抬手之间有杀伐之力包裹其本尊的恐怖力量，与此同时，陈默变成了无敌的存在，东华帝君的身外化身不断溃散当场，被主宰之力击杀，化作漫天飞舞的光辉。
做完这一切，陈默的嘴角咳血，但是他仍旧向东华帝君杀了过去。
主宰之力主宰苍生，有永恒不灭的气息，万千利剑当场覆盖了东华帝君的身躯，所过之处，东华帝君的肉身溢流出大量的鲜血。
“神体已破，我竟然败了。”
东华帝君自嘲一笑，强者之间的对战往往是这么简单，只要对方破开自己的肉身，接下来继续打斗，不过是垂死挣扎而已。
“我有河图洛书，更有主宰之力，实力比不上你，但我陈默也不会比你东华帝君差，你已经杀了舞儿，我无法让你活在世上。”
陈默目光闪烁片刻，伸手一握，仿佛东华帝君的生命都掌控在陈默手里，伴随着五指合十的一瞬间，东华帝君当场死亡。
轰！
整个宇宙之眼都有无尽霞光涌现，仿佛这是东华帝君的一身精华，扩散天地之际，万物复苏，帝座星更是多了磅礴的元气。
见此，陈默艰难的笑了笑，“东华帝君死亡，一切都烟消云散，舞儿，你看到了吗？”
想到舞儿，陈默内心有些失落，舞儿对他的好永生难忘，纵然他有至高无上的实力，却也无法复活舞儿。
修炼究竟是为了什么？
这一刻，陈默陷入了复杂的状态。
哗！
却在这时，一把带有玄光的长剑贯穿而来，如有灵性，这把长剑停留在陈默的面前，散发无边无际的剑光，让陈默心头一动。
“舞儿，你还守护我身边？”
陈默凝视着这把长剑，似是看到舞儿站在他面前，整个人都充满了喜悦而有失落的神色，长剑感受到陈默的悲伤，盘旋在陈默的天灵盖之上，仅仅是半柱香时间，陈默旋即凝神笑了下，“罢了罢了，舞儿为了让我开心，我陈默也不能哭丧着脸。”
“心中有所爱，所爱隔山海，山可平，天可崩，舞儿还在，世界就是完美的。”
“东华帝君死亡，天下太平了。”外面，人群涌动，传来了嘈杂的声音。
陈默来到外界，望着那些熟悉的身影，他走了过去，众人看到陈默都肃然起敬，是这个男子以一己之力击杀东华帝君，拯救了所有人。
陈默来到李素芳和陈兢业的面前，抬起头来含笑道：“爹娘。”
content_en:
Chapter 2002: Right and Wrong, Ending the Destiny (Finale)
"Haha~!" Emperor Donghua laughed and said: "If you don't care for yourself, heaven and earth will destroy you. Do you think that I, Emperor Donghua, value love and justice as much as you, Chen Mo? In my eyes, anyone who can be used can become a chess piece. As for feelings, it depends on whether the chess piece can play a role for me."
"If you don't care for yourself, you will be punished by heaven and earth. Emperor Donghua, I underestimated you."
Chen Mo said: "The battle at this time is already a stranger. Emperor Donghua, I originally wanted to look at the bright moon, but the bright moon shines on the ditch. One of us will die, but before that, I will deal with the family affairs first."
After Chen Mo finished speaking, he waved his big hand, and the power of dominance enveloped Chen Fan's body. In an instant, Chen Fan's expression fell into endless pain. His five elements and all strength were forcibly taken away by Chen Mo.
In just an instant, Chen Fan became a mortal with no cultivation.
Seeing this scene, the corner of Samsara Taoist's mouth twitched, "Chen Mo, how can you deprive Chen Fan of his power?"
After hearing this, Chen Mo said calmly: "Chen Fan was born in the world of five elements. Everything he has is given by me, Chen Mo, including life. You, Emperor Donghua, are not a qualified chess player."
As soon as these words were spoken, it was like a slap on Emperor Donghua's face, making his expression extremely ugly.
He turned out not to be a qualified chess player.
After many years, Emperor Donghua failed for the first time, and he was defeated at the hands of his disciple.
However, Emperor Donghua quickly withdrew his ugly look and looked at Chen Mo again with suspicion, "Chen Mo, even if I lose Chen Fan as a chess piece, I still have other ways to deal with you, and with my strength, I can kill you on the spot."
"In the last battle, if I lose, Hetuluoshu will belong to you, Emperor Donghua." Chen Mo answered Emperor Donghua's words. Emperor Donghua nodded slightly and said: "If I lose, the world will belong to you, Chen Mo."
Chen Mo split the reincarnation path, merged Chen Fan into the reincarnation, and then looked at Emperor Donghua without any distracting thoughts.
At this moment, he knew that he was going to have a life-and-death battle with Emperor Donghua, and the result would affect the entire fairyland.
"Kill."
At this moment, Emperor Donghua cherished his words like gold and walked towards Chen Mo. External incarnations appeared from outside his body. These external incarnations had the cultivation of Tianzun and appeared to be powerful and extraordinary.
That terrifying power made Chen Mo's heart heavy. The power of dominance was gathered from his body and integrated into his internal organs and limbs, making Chen Mo look completely terrifying.
"Bang! Bang bang!" Emperor Donghua's attacks continued to fall outside Chen Mo's body, and the space exploded with destructive power, causing the power of the five elements to rise around Chen Mo. Soon, the power of the five elements turned into protective aura, and Hetu Luoshu spiraled out with a 360-degree brilliance.
Buzz!
Chen Mo walked towards Emperor Donghua step by step. When he raised his hand, there was a killing force that enveloped the terrifying power of his true form. At the same time, Chen Mo turned into an invincible existence. The incarnation of Emperor Donghua kept collapsing on the spot, being killed by the power of domination, turning into a radiance flying in the sky.
After doing all this, Chen Mo coughed up blood at the corner of his mouth, but he still killed Emperor Donghua.
The power of domination dominates the common people, and has the aura of eternity. Thousands of sharp swords covered Emperor Donghua's body on the spot. Wherever they passed, Emperor Donghua's body overflowed with a large amount of blood.
"My divine body has been broken, and I was defeated."
Emperor Donghua laughed at himself. Battles between strong men were often so simple. As long as the other party broke through his body, the fight would continue, which was nothing more than a death struggle.
"I have Hetu Luoshu, and I have more power to dominate. I am not as strong as you, but I, Chen Mo, will not be worse than you, Emperor Donghua. You have already killed Wu'er, and I can't let you live in the world."
Chen Mo's eyes flickered for a moment, and he stretched out his hand to hold it, as if Emperor Donghua's life was in Chen Mo's hands. At the moment when his fingers were clasped together, Emperor Donghua died on the spot.
boom!
Endless rays of light emerged throughout the Eye of the Universe, as if this was the essence of Emperor Donghua. As it spread across the heaven and earth, all things revived, and the Emperor's Constellation Star gained even more majestic vitality.
Seeing this, Chen Mo smiled with difficulty, "Emperor Donghua died and everything disappeared. Wu'er, did you see it?"
Thinking of Wu'er, Chen Mo felt a little disappointed. Wu'er would never forget his kindness. Even though he had supreme strength, he could not revive Wu'er.
What is the purpose of cultivation?
At this moment, Chen Mo fell into a complicated state.
Wow!
But at this moment, a long sword with mysterious light penetrated through it. As if it was spiritual, the long sword stayed in front of Chen Mo, emitting boundless sword light, which made Chen Mo's heart move.
"Wu'er, are you still guarding me?"
Chen Mo stared at the long sword, as if he saw Wu'er standing in front of him, his whole person was full of joy and a look of loss. The long sword felt Chen Mo's sadness, hovering above Chen Mo's Tianling Cap. For only half a stick of incense, Chen Mo immediately smiled attentively, "That's all, Wu'er wants to make me happy, and I, Chen Mo, can't cry with a sad face."
"If there is love in my heart, and my love is across the mountains and seas, the mountains can be leveled, the sky can collapse, but Wu'er is still there, and the world is perfect."
"Emperor Donghua is dead and the world is at peace." Outside, the crowd surged and noisy voices came.
Chen Mo came to the outside world and looked at those familiar figures. He walked over and everyone was in awe when they saw Chen Mo. It was this man who single-handedly killed Emperor Donghua and saved everyone.
Chen Mo came to Li Sufang and Chen Jingye, raised his head and said with a smile: "Mom and Dad."
title_en: Chapter 2002 The ending of right and wrong, the end of the world Chapter 2001 The fire of life is shed
